g.text: p(0) = 0.0366 < 0.05 | 0 is OUT of the CI
Different slices. Always the same decision at their intersection.
Blue = vertical non-rejection region for b = 0 Orange = horizontal confidence interval
Read vertically: is the dot on the blue segment? Read horizontally: is it on the orange segment?
Both ask whether the SAME dot lies in the shaded band. No reflection or exchange of coordinates is needed.

text.tspan: Model: =+−1, ∼Exponential(1); ∈. Each null rejects 2.5% in each tail.
